maddeler.e:
نبتلع (form VIII)
# نَبْتَلِعُ (nabtaliʕu) /nab.ta.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# نُبْتَلَعُ (nubtalaʕu) /nub.ta.la.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# نَبْتَلِعَ (nabtaliʕa) /nab.ta.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# نُبْتَلَعَ (nubtalaʕa) /nub.ta.la.ʕa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
